main.description: An argument made about a proposal, under the author's own name. Deliberation is deliberately attributable — debate is meant to be owned by whoever makes it — which is why it is not covered by the ballot freeze of OD-7 §5c.

proposal.description: The proposal this argument is about.

author.description: DID of whoever makes the argument. The record lives in their own repo, so it is attributable to them regardless.

stance.description: What the argument does to the proposal.
